parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Explain why nitrogen gas is so unreactive.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Despite the low reactivity of $\text{N}_2$, oxides of nitrogen occur in the atmosphere through both natural and man-made processes.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Explain why oxides of nitrogen can be produced by internal combustion engines.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State and explain, using a suitable equation, how oxides of nitrogen produced by internal combustion engines can be prevented from reaching the atmosphere.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: State the role of nitrogen dioxide, $\text{NO}_2$, in the formation of acid rain by oxides of sulfur. Write suitable equations to explain this role.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text: Suggest an equation to show how $\text{NO}_2$ can contribute **directly** to acid rain.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain how the uncontrolled use of nitrate fertilisers on land can lead to a severe reduction in water quality in rivers.
